supporting_quotes.exact: Nine major versions of the architecture have been defined to date, denoted by the version numbers 1 to 9. Of these, the first three versions are now obsolete

claims.rationale: claim 主张：已定义 9 个主要版本（编号 1-9）且前三个已废弃。引文区间 [0,106) 明确 'Nine major versions of the architecture have been defined to date, denoted by the version numbers 1 to 9.'，区间 [106,157) 明确 'Of these, the first three versions are now obsolete'。两个子命题均被直接表述，无冲突，判定 supported。

supporting_quotes.exact: Is the 64-bit Execution state, meaning addresses are held in 64-bit registers, and instructions in the base instruction set can use 64-bit registers for their processing. AArch64 state supports the A64 instruction set

observations.subject: AArch64
observations.object: 地址存于 64 位寄存器；基础指令集可用 64 位寄存器处理

claims.rationale: claim 的三个要素均见于引文：64 位执行状态及地址存于 64 位寄存器、基础指令集指令可用 64 位寄存器处理，见区间 [0,171)；'AArch64 state supports the A64 instruction set' 见区间 [171,217)。逐点对应且无矛盾，判定 supported。

supporting_quotes.exact:
The architecture defines four Exception levels: EL0, EL1, EL2, and EL3. 
      
     
    
   
    
     
     R 
     VPSDB 
     
     
      
      EL3 is the highest Exception level and EL0 the lowest

claims.rationale: claim 主张四个异常级别 EL0-EL3 且 EL3 最高、EL0 最低。引文区间 [0,71) 'The architecture defines four Exception levels: EL0, EL1, EL2, and EL3.' 覆盖级别数量与命名；引文中段为排版噪声（空格/R/VPSDB，区间 [71,151)），区间 [151,204) 'EL3 is the highest Exception level and EL0 the lowest' 覆盖高低次序。要点全部对应，判定 supported。

supporting_quotes.exact: 31 general-purpose registers, R0 to R30. Each can be accessed as:
A 64-bit general-purpose register named X0 to X30.
A 32-bit general-purpose register named W0 to W30.

qualifiers.access: each can be accessed as (两种视图)

observations.subject: AArch64 通用寄存器
observations.object: 命名为 X0 至 X30

observations.subject: AArch64 通用寄存器
observations.object: 命名为 W0 至 W30

claims.rationale: claim 三要素分别由三条同源引文覆盖：31 个通用寄存器 R0-R30 且'Each can be accessed as' 见区间 [0,65)（evidence-29cc639ee281）；64 位视图 X0-X30 见 [0,50)（evidence-1061d87ee77e）；32 位视图 W0-W30 见 [0,50)（evidence-8c92e4905685）。三条引文相互一致、共同支持 claim，判定 supported。

supporting_quotes.exact: moves over to a 4-instruction/cycle decode path rising to eight 16-bit instructions, up from three with the A75

observations.subject: Cortex-A76
observations.object: 每周期 4 条指令（对应 8 条 16-bit 指令）

claims.rationale: claim 主张 A76 解码宽度为每周期 4 条、对比 A75 的 3 条。引文区间 [17,48) '4-instruction/cycle decode path' 给出 A76 的解码宽度；区间 [85,111) 'up from three with the A75' 明确提升自 A75 的三条。两要素均直接对应（'rising to eight 16-bit instructions' [54,70) 为补充细节，与 claim 不冲突），判定 supported。

supporting_quotes.exact: the same 64KB, 4-way set associative L1 cache and 256-512KB private L2

observations.subject: Cortex-A76
observations.object: 64KB 4 路组相联 L1 cache 与 256-512KB 私有 L2

qualifiers.relation: the same（与前代相同，对应'保持'）

claims.rationale: claim 主张 A76 保持 64KB 4 路组相联 L1 与 256-512KB 私有 L2。引文区间 [9,45) '64KB, 4-way set associative L1 cache' 与区间 [50,70) '256-512KB private L2' 直接给出两项规格；前缀 'the same' [0,9) 表明与前代一致，对应 claim 的'保持'。判定 supported。

supporting_quotes.exact: paired up with two SIMD NEON execution pipelines, only one of which can handle floating-point divide and multiply-accumulate instructions. Both of these dual 128-bit

observations.subject: Cortex-A76
observations.predicate: 配有 SIMD NEON 执行流水线

qualifiers.restriction: 仅其中一条可处理浮点除法与乘加指令

claims.rationale: claim 主张两条 SIMD NEON 流水线、仅一条可处理浮点除法与乘加。引文区间 [0,48) 'paired up with two SIMD NEON execution pipelines' 覆盖数量；区间 [49,138) 'only one of which can handle floating-point divide and multiply-accumulate instructions' 覆盖限制条件。两个要点均直接对应，判定 supported（区间 [138,165) 的 'dual 128-bit' 因引文截断不影响判定）。

supporting_quotes.exact: In the Arm memory model, the Shareability memory attribute indicates the degree to which hardware must ensure memory coherency between a set of observers. See Memory types and attributes.

observations.subject: Arm 内存模型中的 Shareability 内存属性
observations.object: 硬件须在一组观察者之间保证内存一致性的程度

claims.rationale: claim 为对定义的转述。引文区间 [25,154) 'the Shareability memory attribute indicates the degree to which hardware must ensure memory coherency between a set of observers.' 与 claim 的谓词-宾语结构一一对应（'多个观察者'对应 'a set of observers'，语义等价）。区间 [154,187) 为交叉引用，与判定无关。判定 supported。

supporting_quotes.exact: The implementation of a memory system depends heavily on the microarchitecture and therefore many details of the memory system are IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED. The Arm architecture defines the application level interface to the memory system, including a hierarchical memory system with multiple levels of cache

observations.subject: Arm 架构
observations.predicate: 定义应用层可见的分层存储系统
observations.object: 含多级 cache 的 hierarchical memory system

qualifiers.implementation_defined: 存储系统许多细节为 IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED

claims.rationale: claim 两个子命题均在引文中直接表述：'many details of the memory system are IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED' 见区间 [93,154)；'The Arm architecture defines the application level interface to the memory system, including a hierarchical memory system with multiple levels of cache' 见区间 [155,306)。claim 的'应用层可见'对应 'application level interface'，'多级 cache'对应 'multiple levels of cache'，判定 supported。
